# MyGravelGuy.com

> Metro-by-metro bulk landscape materials delivery. Order gravel, sand, topsoil, and mulch online with instant delivered pricing by ZIP code. MyGravelGuy launches one metro at a time, backed by a real local delivery operation in each market — not a nationwide broker network.

## About

MyGravelGuy delivers bulk gravel, sand, topsoil, and mulch directly to homeowners and contractors, metro by metro. We are not a nationwide marketplace; we launch and support one metro at a time. Our sister yard, Eastern Landscape & Mason Supply (Center Moriches, NY), has completed thousands of bulk material deliveries on Long Island since 2023 — the operational playbook behind every metro we launch.

**How ordering works**: enter your delivery address, choose a material and quantity, see an instant delivered price for your ZIP, pick a delivery date, and pay online. No quote-and-wait process for served ZIPs. A 3-ton minimum applies per order.

**Tagline**: "Do You Have a Gravel Guy?"

## Markets

- **Dallas–Fort Worth, TX** — launching. https://mygravelguy.com/dallas-fort-worth
  - Gravel delivery: https://mygravelguy.com/dallas-fort-worth/gravel-delivery
  - Mulch delivery: https://mygravelguy.com/dallas-fort-worth/mulch-delivery
  - Sand delivery: https://mygravelguy.com/dallas-fort-worth/sand-delivery
  - Soil delivery: https://mygravelguy.com/dallas-fort-worth/soil-delivery
  - Pricing is in setup with local partner yards; treat any price shown as an estimate until noted otherwise on the page.
- **Long Island, NY** — pilot market, fulfilled by our sister yard Eastern Landscape & Mason Supply out of Center Moriches, NY. https://mygravelguy.com/long-island

Additional metros will be added to this list as they launch — do not assume nationwide coverage beyond the markets listed here.

## Products & Services

Bulk gravel (crushed stone, driveway gravel, pea gravel, crusher run), sand, topsoil, and mulch. Instant delivered pricing by ZIP code within served metros only. 3-ton minimum. Free delivery included in the delivered price.
